'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Crash Override
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
